title: Member Cost-Share Points — Insulin Pump Program Remittance Analysis Note
content:
**Note.** On a hardship waiver on an Insulin Pump Program, points are added to the share according to the share of the named remittance's allowed amount the payer left to the member — its allowed amount less the payer's payment, divided by its allowed amount:

- where that share is at least 20 percent (the high cost-share percent), 10 points (the full cost-share points) are added to the share;
- where it is above zero but below 20 percent, 5 points (the partial cost-share points) are added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

The named remittance is the payer remittance posting the approved hardship application names; a named posting that itemizes no allowed amount leaves no member share to read, and nothing is added.

| Hypothetical named remittance | Member share | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| Allowed $200.00, payer paid $160.00 | 40 divided by 200 is 20 percent | 10 |
| Allowed $200.00, payer paid $170.00 | 15 percent | 5 |
| Allowed $200.00, payer paid $200.00 | 0 percent | none |
